note: Homes that sort items with their own scripts: Dova Stash leaves them alone, so two systems never move the same items. An entry applies while its plugin is loaded. Without cells or containers, every cell from the plugin is left alone; with cells, only those cells (from any plugin); with containers, only those containers are never used (a reference, or a base container: all its references). Add your own in another file in this folder (DESIGN 9.1).
